ADD.description: Adds two field elements from memory
ADD.details: Performs field addition modulo p. Both operands must have the same type tag. The result inherits the tag from the operands. Overflow wraps according to the field modulus.

DIV.description: Divides two integer values from memory
DIV.details: Performs integer division. Both operands must have the same integral type tag (not FIELD). Division by zero throws an error. The result inherits the tag from the operands.

FDIV.details: Performs field division by computing the multiplicative inverse modulo p. Both operands must have FIELD type tag. Division by zero throws an error. The result has FIELD tag.

SHL.description: Shifts an integer value left by specified bits
SHL.details: Performs left bit shift. Both operands must have the same integral type tag. The shift amount is taken from the second operand. The result inherits the tag from the operands.

SET.description: Sets a memory location to an immediate value with specified tag
SET.details: Stores an immediate value at the specified memory offset with the given type tag. The value is encoded directly in the instruction. Multiple wire formats support different value sizes (8-bit, 16-bit, 32-bit, 64-bit, 128-bit, and full field).

MOV.details: Copies a value and its type tag from the source memory offset to the destination offset. The tag is preserved in the copy operation.
